Retrieve chunked posterior expectation draws with paired contrasts

Source: R/prediction_helpers.R
chunked_epred.Rd

Retrieve chunked posterior expectation draws with paired contrasts

Usage

chunked_epred(
  model,
  newdata,
  newdata_b = NULL,
  draw_ids = NULL,
  chunk_size = 256L,
  re_formula = NA,
  predict_fun = brms::posterior_epred,
  summarise_fun = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A fitted model, passed to `predict_fun`.

newdata

Prediction grid for condition A.

newdata_b

Optional matched prediction grid for condition B.

draw_ids

Optional indices, identical for every chunk and condition.

chunk_size

Number of prediction locations per chunk.

re_formula

Group-level effects specification.

predict_fun

Function accepting model, newdata, re_formula, draw_ids. Defaults to `brms::posterior_epred`.

summarise_fun

Optional function applied to each draws-by-location chunk. If NULL, return a list of draw matrices.

Value

List of chunk outputs in prediction-grid order.
